crops.name: Pumpkins
crops.tagline: Small patch, so once they're gone, they're gone!
crops.description: Big Loretta pumpkins, proper carvers. It's only a small patch, so once they're gone, they're gone!
crops.closedNote: Pumpkin picking is finished for this year. Thank you to everyone who came along!
crops.imageAlt: Two children sitting on pumpkins next to a flowerpot scarecrow in the Llannant Farm pumpkin patch

crops.name: Sweetcorn & summer veg
crops.description: Sweetcorn picked straight from the stalk. In season you can also buy it at Shepherds Fruit and Veg on Gorseinon High Street.
crops.closedNote: Closed for 2026. Thank you to everyone who came along!

facts.label: Before you set off
facts.text: Check our Facebook page for any last-minute changes.

faqs.a: No, just turn up during opening hours. It's a small patch, so come early for the best pick.
If we have to close, we'll post on our Facebook page and update this page.
